rssAutomation.title: RSS Automation
rssAutomation.description: Poll tracker RSS feeds on a fixed interval and add matching cross-seeds automatically.
rssAutomation.rssIntervalTooltip: Automation processes the full feed from every enabled Torznab indexer on each run. Minimum interval is {{min}} minutes to avoid hammering indexers.
rssAutomation.noRunsRecorded: No RSS automation runs recorded yet.

hardlinkMode.title: Hardlink / Reflink Mode
hardlinkMode.noActiveInstances: No active instances. Add instances first.
hardlinkMode.description: Create hardlinked or reflinked (copy-on-write) file trees for cross-seeds. Each instance can be configured independently. The base directory must be on the same filesystem as the instance's download paths.
hardlinkMode.reflinkNote: Reflink mode allows safe cross-seeding of torrents with extra/missing files. When extra files are present, qui triggers a recheck; if below threshold, the torrent stays paused for manual review.
hardlinkMode.enableLocalAccess: Enable "Local filesystem access" in Instance Settings to use hardlink or reflink modes.
hardlinkMode.regularDescription: Reuse existing files in place. Fast, no extra disk space.
hardlinkMode.hardlinkDescription: Create hardlinked file trees. No extra disk space, strict piece-boundary check.
hardlinkMode.reflinkDescription: Create reflinked clones. Safer for extra/missing files, mitigates corruption best.
hardlinkMode.baseDirectoriesDescription: Comma-separated paths. The first directory on the same filesystem as the source will be used.
hardlinkMode.fallbackToRegular: Fallback to regular mode on error
hardlinkMode.fallbackDescription: If {{mode}} fails (e.g., different filesystems), fall back to regular mode using existing files.

toast.noLocalFilesystemAccess: Instance "{{name}}" does not have local filesystem access enabled.
toast.baseDirectoryRequired: Base directory must be set first.

blocklist.title: Cross-Seed Blocklist
blocklist.noInstancesDescription: Add instances to manage blocked cross-seed infohashes.
blocklist.description: Prevent specific infohashes from being injected on a per-instance basis.
blocklist.entriesDescription: Entries are applied only to the selected instance.

toast.invalidInfohash: Infohash must be 40 or 64 hex characters

dirScan.title: Directory Scanner
dirScan.description: Scan local directories for completed downloads and automatically cross-seed them.
dirScan.noLocalAccessWarning: No qBittorrent instances have local filesystem access enabled. Enable it in instance settings to use the Directory Scanner.
dirScan.scanDirectoriesDescription: Configure directories to scan for cross-seedable content.
dirScan.addDirectoryPrompt: Add a directory to start scanning.

toast.scanCanceled: Scan canceled. Next run will recheck the directory and retry unfinished items.
